title: 打个电话就清了
summary: The director offers her the easy way out, quietly, without cruelty and without any interest in whether she is guilty.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) stands at the desk on the far side; 苏小满 (S1) stands on the NEAR side of the desk with her back to the door, facing him; 钱经理 (S3) is behind and to the director's left, saying nothing; the crowd is flat against the doorway walls.
[Shot 1] Medium over the desk: 周总监 (S6) rests one hand lightly on the desk edge beside the card and speaks to her in the same low, slow, level Mandarin, as if explaining something simple: [Chinese] 真是别人给你的，你打个电话，就清了。
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, reverse single on 苏小满 (S1); she listens without nodding, without softening.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, slight push in past her shoulder on 钱经理 (S3) in the background, who is watching the director's back uneasily.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on her face. She does not answer yet and nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A low unhurried voice, the desk creaking faintly as he leans, the doorway holding its breath, the ceiling lights.

title: 我不想求他
summary: She refuses the escape route and says why, in the quietest possible way.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) on the near side of the desk with her back to the door; 周总监 (S6) on the far side with one hand on the desk; 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing; the black card between 苏小满 and 周总监; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) looks at the desk, not at the card, and answers in a low flat Mandarin with no self-pity in it at all: [Chinese] 那个人，让我帮他办点事。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, she lifts her eyes to the director and finishes, still quiet, and the room hears the refusal for what it is: [Chinese] 我不想求他。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, reverse onto 周总监 (S6), whose expression does not change; he simply keeps looking at her for a beat longer than expected.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, wide of the still room. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: Two quiet sentences, a long pause after them, the crowd at the door breathing, the wall clock ticking.
music: A soft low piano note held under the refusal.

title: 你还挺牛
summary: The manager cannot let it alone and sneers from behind the director's shoulder.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) at the far side of the desk with his back three-quarters to the door; 苏小满 (S1) on the near side; 钱经理 (S3) standing behind and left of the director.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) leans out around the director's shoulder, folds his arms and speaks in a light jeering nasal Mandarin, enjoying the interruption: [Chinese] 你还挺牛。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, 钱经理 (S3) pushes it further, throwing his chin toward the doorway crowd for the laugh: [Chinese] 人家大户人家求你，你还端上了。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, a couple of people at the door snigger; 周总监 (S6) does not turn around or speak.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on 苏小满 (S1) across the desk, unmoved. She says nothing.
soundscape: A sneering voice cutting into the quiet, a few muffled laughs from the doorway, a coat shifting, the lights.

title: 不想跟这种人有关系
summary: She corrects him flatly, and the sentence she uses lands on the whole room.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) on the near side of the desk; 周总监 (S6) on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) behind the director's left shoulder with his arms folded; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1): she turns her head just enough to take in the manager, and answers in her low even Mandarin, one clause at a time: [Chinese] 不是他求我。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.400, she returns her eyes to the director and finishes it plainly, without emphasis: [Chinese] 是我，不想跟这种人有关系。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.400, wide: the room absorbs it. 钱经理's (S3) smile comes off his face; the doorway crowd has gone very still.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on 周总监 (S6) watching her. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: Two plain sentences, then a stillness with real weight in it, the ceiling lights, one shoe scraping at the door.
music: A single sustained low string note.

title: 打完，两清
summary: The director closes the door on all other options: one call, or take the blame.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) stands on the far side of the desk, 苏小满 (S1) on the near side with her back to the door, 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing, the card between 苏小满 and 周总监; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium: 周总监 (S6) straightens up off the desk, buttons his jacket with one hand and lays out the terms in that same low level Mandarin, evenly, as a statement of fact rather than a threat: [Chinese] 打完，两清。你走你的路。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, closer on 周总监's (S6) face as he adds the alternative with no change of tone at all: [Chinese] 要不，你承认是你偷的。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.400, reverse onto 苏小满 (S1), listening, absolutely still, hands at her sides.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on the two of them across the desk. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A low measured voice, cloth shifting as he buttons the jacket, the room held still around it, the clock.

title: 你自己离职
summary: The second half of the offer: they will look the other way if she simply disappears.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 周总监 (S6) on the far side of the desk; 苏小满 (S1) on the near side; 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing; the card flat on the desk between 苏小满 and 周总监; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium: 周总监 (S6) tucks both hands behind his back and speaks without looking away from her, calm and businesslike: [Chinese] 我们也不想麻烦，当做不知道。你自己离职。
[Shot 2] At 00:07.400, insert on the desk: the black card lying perfectly square on the dark wood, the keys and the pen beside it.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, pan up to 苏小满's (S1) face; she is looking at the card now, not at him.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold. She says nothing, and neither does anyone else.
soundscape: A calm even voice, the hush of a room where nobody wants to breathe loudly, the lights, a faint tap of the clock.

title: 行吧
summary: A three-second pause, then she agrees — and the room, which wanted a fight, gets something worse.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) on the near side of the desk looking down at the card; 周总监 (S6) on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) behind him; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on 钱经理's (S3) face: he cannot bear the wait and snaps it out in a short impatient Mandarin: [Chinese] 打不打。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, wide, held: the room absolutely still, the card on the desk, everyone watching the woman standing over it. Three full seconds pass with no movement at all except the second hand on the wall clock.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, close on 苏小满 (S1): she lifts her chin, breathes out once, and says it quietly in a low flat Mandarin, giving nothing away: [Chinese] 行吧。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on her face. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: An impatient bark, then three seconds with only the clock, then two quiet words.
music: A low held note that resolves down as she agrees.

title: 看号码
summary: Silent beat: she picks the card up, reads the number on the back, hesitates over it, then takes out her phone and dials.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands on the NEAR side of the desk with her back to the door; the black card lies on the desk in front of her; 周总监 (S6) and 钱经理 (S3) watch from the far side; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium: she reaches down and picks the card up off the desk, turning it over in her fingers.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, extreme close-up on the back of the card: a line of small stamped numerals catching the blind-light.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.200, close on her face as she reads them; her thumb comes down and rests on the numbers without pressing anything, and stays there.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, she takes an old phone out of her other pocket, thumbs the screen awake and keys the number in one deliberate digit at a time, then presses call. Nobody speaks in this whole beat.
soundscape: Card lifted off wood, her own breathing, the dull plastic clicks of old phone keys, the room held still around her.
music: A soft low piano figure, sparse and hesitant.

title: 响铃
summary: Silent beat: speakerphone on, the phone on the desk, two rings, and the whole room stops breathing.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) holds her old phone in one hand and the card in the other, on the NEAR side of the desk; 周总监 (S6) and 钱经理 (S3) stand on the far side; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on her thumb tapping the speakerphone icon; the small speaker grille lights up.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, she sets the phone down flat on the desk between herself and 周总监 (S6), screen up, and lets go of it, the black card still held in her other hand.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, extreme close-up on the phone: the screen shows the number dialling, then the call timer ticking up. One ring. A second ring.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, wide across the room: nobody moves. 钱经理 (S3) has stopped smirking; 周总监 (S6) is looking at the phone; the doorway crowd is rigid. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: The electronic dial tone, two loud rings on a tiny speaker filling the room, the fluorescent hum underneath, one person swallowing.

title: 喂，我是苏小满
summary: The call connects and she gives her name to the room as much as to the phone.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the old phone lies flat on the desk on speaker, screen lit, between 苏小满 (S1) on the near side and 周总监 (S6) on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on the phone on the desk, then up to 苏小满's (S1) face as she leans slightly over it and speaks in a low, completely flat Mandarin, as if reading a room number out: [Chinese] 喂。我是苏小满。你们留的卡，在我这。
[Shot 2] At 00:07.000, quick cut to the doorway: every face fixed on the phone on the desk, nobody moving, one man with his mouth open.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, 周总监 (S6) lowers his eyes to the phone and stays very still.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on the lit screen. Nobody else in the room speaks.
soundscape: Her flat quiet voice close to the mic, the phone's slight static, the room holding still enough to hear the ceiling lights.

title: 哪一号
summary: The voice at the other end stalls, then asks a question that makes no sense to anyone in the room.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the phone lies on the desk on speaker; 苏小满 (S1) stands over it on the near side; 周总监 (S6) and 钱经理 (S3) on the far side; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up on the phone speaker grille as a pause stretches on the line — a hiss of open air, no words.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the unseen man at the other end (S13), who is never seen in this beat and has no face, comes through the tiny speaker in a wary clipped Mandarin, and the whole room hears it: [Chinese] 您说，哪一号。
[Shot 3] At 00:07.400, cut to 钱经理's (S3) face: a flicker of confusion, his smirk not quite back.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, back to 苏小满 (S1), who just looks down at the card in her hand. Nobody in the room speaks.
soundscape: Phone-line hiss on a small speaker, one clipped male phrase, one person at the door breathing.

title: 第玖号
summary: She reads the number off the card, and something on the other end changes completely.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the phone lies flat on the desk on speaker; 苏小满 (S1) holds the black card on the near side; 周总监 (S6) on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) turns her wrist and reads the back of the card aloud in her low flat Mandarin: [Chinese] 第玖号。
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, the phone speaker; on the other end a full second of open line, then the sound of a chair pushed back hard and fast footsteps on a hard floor.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.200, the unseen man on the line (S13), still never seen and with no face, comes back — and he is not clipped any more: hurried, careful and suddenly respectful: [Chinese] 苏小姐。您稍等。您别挂。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, cut to 周总监 (S6), who has gone very still, eyes fixed on the phone. Nobody in the room speaks.
soundscape: A flat quiet voice, one second of open line hiss, the thump of a chair and fast footsteps down the phone, a hurried respectful voice.
music: A low note entering quietly under the footsteps.

title: 换人接听
summary: Silent beat: the manager risks a sneer, and on the desk the phone changes hands at the other end.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the phone lies on the desk on speaker; 苏小满 (S1) on the near side holding the card; 钱经理 (S3) and 周总监 (S6) on the far side; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) folds his arms, rocks back on his heels and lets out one short contemptuous laugh through his nose, looking around at the doorway crowd for support.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, close on the phone on the desk: on the line, footsteps stop; there is a small rustle of fabric and the receiver changes hands.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, cut to 苏小满 (S1): she does not react to the laugh at all; her eyes stay on the phone.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, wide of the room held still — the manager smirking, the director not smiling at all, the crowd watching a small lit screen on a desk. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: One nasal snort of a laugh, then on the line the shift of a handset and a different room's ambience: a large quiet space, a soft closing door.

title: 您在哪
summary: A second, calmer voice comes on the line and asks where she is; she tells it plainly and is told to wait.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the phone lies on the desk on speaker with 苏小满 (S1) standing over it on the near side; 周总监 (S6) on the far side; 钱经理 (S3) further along the far side of the desk, back to the window, saying nothing; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on the phone: a second, different voice is on the line now. It is 小罗 (S7) — the same quiet, courteous, completely unhurried man who will walk into this office a few minutes later — and only his voice is heard, never his face: [Chinese] 苏小姐。请问，您在哪。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.400, 苏小满 (S1) answers without looking up, in her own flat low Mandarin: [Chinese] 景宸大厦。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.200, 小罗 (S7) on the line again, still unhurried, with a note of instruction in it now: [Chinese] 您先别走。我们马上到。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, cut wide: the doorway crowd staring at the phone on the desk, and 周总监 (S6) quietly watching 苏小满 (S1) instead of the phone. Nobody in the room speaks.
soundscape: A courteous measured voice on a small speaker, her short flat answer, one more instruction, then only room tone and a distant lift bell.
music: A low sustained string note under the whole exchange.

title: 他们说，马上到
summary: The line goes dead, and she tells the room the news herself.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the phone lies on the desk on speaker; 苏小满 (S1) on the near side; 周总监 (S6) and 钱经理 (S3) on the far side; the crowd at the LEFT doorway.
[Shot 1] Close on the phone screen: the call timer stops and the screen dims; the line clicks off.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, medium: 苏小满 (S1) picks the phone up, presses it dark and puts it back in her pocket, looking at nobody in particular.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, she lays the black card back down on the desk beside the keys, and says it to the room in a completely ordinary low Mandarin, as if reporting the weather: [Chinese] 他们说，马上到。
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, wide, held long: the whole room holding its breath. The crowd in the doorway, the manager, the director — nobody has a reply. Hold on the black card on the desk as the scene settles.
soundscape: The line clicking off, her phone going back into cloth, then a room so quiet the ceiling lights are audible, the clock ticking.
music: A single low struck note that sustains into the next beat.
